description: This source file implements the 'BridgeStateReaderImpl' class's 'read_state' method, which reads network bridge interface names from the Linux sysfs filesystem under '/sys/class/net/'. It interacts with directory entries and constructs a set of interface names for a given bridge.

classes.name: BridgeStateReaderImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a class responsible for reading network bridge state, specifically reading interface names associated with a network bridge.

methods.name: bool read_state(const std::string & bridge_name,std::set<std::string> & iface_names)
methods.description: Reads the list of interface names associated with a specified network bridge by accessing the sysfs directory '/sys/class/net/{bridge_name}/brif'. It populates a set with interface names found in the directory.
